## RecCheck 1.17.4 — Windows

Nightly POS receipt audit for the protel checkcharge1 report (.oxps). Everything runs locally — no data leaves the machine.

### The home screen fits the window

It kept growing — menu categories come and go, the checklist is as long as the night needs — and on a smaller screen the button that starts the audit could end up below the fold.

Now the page is the window. Everything above the checklist keeps its size; the checklist is the only part that can be arbitrarily long, so it is the only part that gives: the card shrinks to the room available and the list scrolls inside it, with the bottom row fading out while there is more underneath. A short list on a big screen looks exactly as it always did.

Checked in a real browser at six window sizes from 1920×1080 down to 900×480, with nothing on the list and with thirty things on it: everything fits, and the audit button is always where you left it.

### The τ waits 50 ms, and the wait is yours to set

1.17.3 waited 100 ms before pressing the Enter after the τ. That is longer than protel needs. It is 50 ms now, and *PROTEL SHORTCUTS* has the number in a box beside the checkbox — if it wants to be 30 or 120 on some other night, that no longer needs a new version.

### Install

Download **RecCheck-Setup.exe** below (under *Assets*) and open it. It installs in a few seconds — no administrator password — and puts **RecCheck** on the Desktop and in the Start Menu. If an older RecCheck is running, the installer closes it and relaunches when done.

If Windows shows a blue *"Windows protected your PC"* screen: click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is unsigned, not harmful).

Existing installs update themselves: the app downloads this version in the background and offers it with the blue ↑ button — no reinstall by hand needed.
